privacy.title: Privacy and cookie notice
privacy.description: This notice explains the information Impacticker uses to provide the service and operate advertising, along with your choices.
privacy.accountContent: Your email, authentication information, and saved instruments are processed to provide service features. The authentication token is stored on your device and used only to authenticate API requests.
privacy.preferencesContent: Cookies or browser storage may be used to remember preferences such as your display language and theme.
privacy.advertisingContent: When advertising is enabled, third-party advertising providers, including Google, may use cookies and similar technologies for ad delivery, frequency management, aggregate reporting, and fraud prevention. Impacticker requests non-personalized ads by default.
privacy.targetingContent: We do not use your holdings, watchlist, or news reading history to create advertising audiences or directly send this information to advertising providers.
privacy.choicesContent: You can review ad personalization settings in Google Ads Settings. Where regional consent is required, we provide Google's certified consent management experience.
privacy.contactPending: A dedicated privacy contact email will be published here before advertising is enabled.

advertising.title: Advertising policy
advertising.description: These principles separate advertising revenue from news analysis and ensure that users can clearly identify advertising.
advertising.labelContent: Paid advertisements and sponsored content are clearly labeled as advertisements or sponsorships near the content.
advertising.independenceContent: Advertising agreements do not affect news collection, AI impact direction, impact scores, probabilities, or assessment reasons.
advertising.placementContent: Ads are not placed on sign-in, error, or loading screens, or near portfolio add and remove controls. Ads only appear in designated areas that do not interfere with content.
advertising.prohibitedContent: We do not allow ads that guarantee returns, make false or exaggerated performance claims, promote illegal financial products, or mislead users.
advertising.personalizationContent: Impacticker does not use portfolio data for advertising targeting and requests non-personalized Google ads by default.
